note:
⛔ SNG-499. THE MECHANICAL EFFECT VOCABULARY. Erik: 'I think we need a GAME MECHANIC LIST we can evaluate all of these skills against — a full mapping of every skill and rank based on WHAT IT DOES at each level. Then when we get skills like these we can easily see that they are NOT CLEARLY MAPPING to what they do.'
⚠️ THIS IS THE INSTRUMENT THE AUDIT HAS BEEN MISSING. `functions` say what a craft is FOR (bind, reveal). `shape` says how it resolves (strike, guard). ⛔ NEITHER SAYS WHAT HAPPENS AT THE TABLE. This does.
⛔ FIRST MEASUREMENT: 480 OF 952 RANKS — 50% — CLAIM NO RECOGNISABLE MECHANIC IN THEIR GRANT TEXT.
_rule: ⛔ EVERY RANK MUST NAME AT LEAST ONE EFFECT FROM THIS LIST, WITH ITS NUMBER. A rank that cannot is either flavour, a duplicate, or unfinished. ⚠️ A rank may name several; a rank naming none does not ship.

DAMAGE.note: ⛔ ONLY damage/strike shapes roll. hobble/hinder dice are never rolled (CCode Q1).

SOAK.note: per-hit reduction for a duration. Corpus band 2-6.

ANTISOAK.note: ⛔ ADDS TO DAMAGE THAT ALREADY GOT PAST SOAK. Stacks with piercing. New in SNG-498.

HEAL.states: NdX per round or per use
HEAL.note: ⛔ AUTHORED AND UNREAD — 57 abilities, 27 with dice. See healing_intent.json. Ladder L1 1d4, L2 2d4, L3 3d4, L4 4d4.

TEMP_SOAK.states: soak N, empties at contest end

ACTION_LOSS.note: ⚠️ Keening r1. Needs a round-state flag.

UNCONSCIOUS.states: target falls unconscious, resist for action-loss instead

SENSE_SLOT.states: resolves in sense slot, action free
SENSE_SLOT.note: CCODE-45 ships sense→action→bonus; CCODE-51 contests the read.

DENY_READ.note: ⚠️ passive today via senseResistOf; declared choice is new.

REVEAL.states: ⛔ NAME THE SPECIFIC FACT RETURNED — not 'you know about it'
REVEAL.note: ⛔ 130 ranks claim this and most do not say WHAT is returned. The commonest empty mechanic.

CONCEAL.states: unseen against N, or until you act

WARD_AREA.states: named category cannot cross, area A, duration D

BIND_TARGET.states: target cannot take named action for D

SUMMON.states: N entities, duration D, what they can do

MAKE_OBJECT.states: what is made, how long it takes, how long it lasts

SOCIAL_ACCESS.states: ⛔ WHAT DOOR OPENS AND WHOSE COOPERATION — Palework is the model

PERSIST_UNTIL_HEALED.states: effect lasts until a mending craft lifts it
PERSIST_UNTIL_HEALED.note: ⛔ Grey Hand, Grief Strike r3. A real duration class distinct from rounds/days.

PROJECT_TICKS.states: banks progress per world tick to a threshold

_measurement._note: ⛔ REVEAL IS THE COMMONEST CLAIM AND THE EMPTIEST — 130 ranks, most of which say 'you know' without naming what is returned. ⚠️ THAT IS THE SAME FINDING AS THE 519 PERCEIVE ROWS, arriving from a different direction.

_howToUse: ⛔ FOR EACH RANK: name the effect, give its number, and check the effect is WIRED. If it is not wired, the number is intent and must be flagged for CCode. ⚠️ IF NO EFFECT FITS, THE RANK IS NOT A MECHANIC — it is flavour, a duplicate, or unfinished, and the six questions (§32.11) will say which.
